Action: User inputs a prompt in mid-conversation
Passing criteria: New prompt is queued/answered without losing the thread; a running query can be stopped first
Failing criteria: User unable to stop processing previously run query

Action: User hovers a message and clicks Copy
Passing criteria: Message text copied to clipboard (verify with paste); toast / icon change confirms copy; works for both user and assistant messages
Failing criteria: Copy includes HTML tags or markdown artifacts; no visual confirmation after copy

Passing criteria: Bubble turns editable; saving re-runs the turn and keeps the old answer as a branch
Failing criteria: Edit silently drops the downstream replies; no way back to the original

Action: Thumbs up / down on a reply
Passing criteria: Icon fills; thumbs-down asks for a reason; choice sticks after refresh
Failing criteria: Vote doesn't persist; no reason prompt on thumbs-down

Passing criteria: All previous messages cleared from view; attached files shown in knowledge hub; right-side workspace tabs reset; old chat saved to history before reset
Failing criteria: New Chat does not clear context (old context leaks into new prompt); old chat lost entirely (not saved to history); right-side tabs retain stale data

Passing criteria: Thinking steps / loader shown while the query runs; chat still scrollable
Failing criteria: Frozen UI with no progress; can't tell if anything is happening

Action: Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to send and Esc to clear
Passing criteria: Send and clear shortcuts work from the composer
Failing criteria: Shortcuts do nothing

Action: Same chat open in two tabs
Passing criteria: Second tab shows read-only / "open elsewhere" notice
Failing criteria: Both tabs writable; answers clash

Passing criteria: Every clarification input is shown in chat; able to type custom input
Failing criteria: Custom input ignored / lost on submit; on skip nothing is echoed so user can't tell what Ira assumed

Passing criteria: Skip moves on; skip-all proceeds with sensible defaults (defaults TBD)
Failing criteria: Skip blocks progress or wipes earlier answers

Passing criteria: Stays in the same thread and reuses prior context/data
Failing criteria: Treated as a brand new chat; context dropped

Action: User asks a completely different question in the same conversation
Passing criteria: New clarify to run cycle; earlier result still scrollable
Failing criteria: Overwrites the previous result or mixes the two

Action: Drag and drop files / Upload from computer
Passing criteria: Files get uploaded and processed
Failing criteria: Loader graphics until file is loaded; error state if file doesn't get uploaded

Action: Supports different file formats (pdf, csv, xlsx, xlsx-multiple sheets) in single upload
Passing criteria: All types of files get processed together
Failing criteria: Folders with all PDFs allowed, that too of same structure (Akshat code)

Action: User uploads an unsupported file type (e.g. .exe, .zip, .docx)
Passing criteria: Toast: "X files rejected - only CSV, XLSX, XLS, XLSM, ODS, PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG supported"; rejected file does NOT appear in attached list; other valid files in the same batch still upload
Failing criteria: Unsupported file silently added to list; generic "upload failed" with no reason; whole batch rejected because one file is invalid

Action: File over the size limit (50 MB)
Passing criteria: Rejected with a toast naming size + type; valid files in the same batch still go through
Failing criteria: Oversize file added; entire batch fails

Passing criteria: Long pasted text becomes a .txt attachment; pasted image becomes an image attachment
Failing criteria: Paste dumps raw text into the prompt / image lost

Passing criteria: Shows results with fuzzy and semantic search
Failing criteria: In case of 0 results - show '0 results'

Passing criteria: Selected file shows as selected 'checkbox'
Failing criteria: If no files are uploaded/selected, 'Verify with Ira' button is greyed out

Action: Files uploaded or chosen from existing datasets
Passing criteria: Files uploaded/chosen show in 'Added Files'
Failing criteria: For insufficient data files chat response says 'files insufficient'; if no input prompt but file is uploaded - clarification to show

Passing criteria: Ira rethinks and remakes the analysis plan
Failing criteria: Plan stays stale after the new file is added

Action: Remove an attached file before sending
Passing criteria: x removes the chip; file not sent
Failing criteria: Removed file still goes with the query

Action: Tab gets opened when query execution plan is ready
Passing criteria: Shows loader until execution plan is generated
Failing criteria: Tab opens empty / no loader

Action: Opens when a query is run with data attached
Passing criteria: Initially shows all columns of the query; after output, only the used columns are shown
Failing criteria: No files uploaded but prompt is input in chat

Action: Opens just before the output is ready
Passing criteria: Shows the generated query/code
Failing criteria: Code tab stays empty or shows stale code

Action: Opens when the output is shown
Passing criteria: KPIs, Charts and Tables selections
Failing criteria: Output config selection changes don't reflect in the output (in chat)

Action: Workspace flips when a query is saved as workflow
Passing criteria: Plan/Input/Output/Preview tabs appear; old query tabs fade to 'stale' in place
Failing criteria: Tabs don't switch when the mode flips; both sets shown live

Action: User clicks on save as workflow
Passing criteria: Ira asks config (tolerance + thresholds) in the clarification UI - five governance questions (risk to detect, population/period, frequency, what each run outputs, what stays adjustable); after this the BP modal opens; saved workflow reflects wherever necessary in the system; composer locks to 'Workflow mode'
Failing criteria: Modal opens before the governance questions; saved workflow doesn't show up in the library

Passing criteria: Button hidden when there's no table/chart to save
Failing criteria: Button shown; saves an empty workflow

Passing criteria: Modal opens pre-filled with defaults (defaults TBD)
Failing criteria: Skip blocks the save or stores blank config

Passing criteria: Pill becomes read-only 'Workflow mode'; only New Chat resets it
Failing criteria: Can toggle back mid-thread; query and workflow state mix

Action: User closes modal via Cancel / X / Escape
Passing criteria: All three close methods behave identically; confirmation prompt if the form has unsaved data; reopening the modal resets the form (clean state)
Failing criteria: Escape doesn't close the modal; closing without confirmation loses form data; reopening shows old form data

Passing criteria: Print/PDF flow opens with KPIs + table
Failing criteria: Export comes out blank / charts missing

Action: User clicks Add to Dashboard on banner
Passing criteria: Output added to dashboard with success toast; banner dismissed after action; dashboard reflects the new card on next visit
Failing criteria: "Add to Dashboard" enabled but does nothing; banner reappears after dismissal; output added but not visible on dashboard

Passing criteria: Linked; pill shows in the dropdown; report opens from the pill
Failing criteria: Link doesn't persist

Passing criteria: x removes the link; undo offered
Failing criteria: Link stuck; no undo

Passing criteria: Dashboard/Report actions hidden; Export + Save as workflow still available
Failing criteria: Empty card added to dashboard

Action: User types a prompt / picks a template
Passing criteria: 'Audit on Chat' enabled only when there's text; template pre-fills the prompt
Failing criteria: Button fires on an empty prompt; template doesn't fill anything

Passing criteria: Files carried forward and pre-mapped to inputs; count chip shown
Failing criteria: Carried files lost on entering the builder

Passing criteria: Prompt arrives pre-filled and the draft auto-generates
Failing criteria: Lands on an empty step 1

Passing criteria: Shows '0 workflows' empty state
Failing criteria: Blank / broken rail (open: empty state not defined)

Passing criteria: 2-4 questions one at a time; option click custom text and keyboard 1-4 all work
Failing criteria: Overlay skippable into a half-defined workflow

Passing criteria: Confirms "discard this draft?" before leaving
Failing criteria: Leaves silently; half-saved draft

Passing criteria: Routes to the input; 3s auto-verify advances to mapping
Failing criteria: Doesn't advance even though the required input is filled

Passing criteria: All 3 union into one input; verify fires once after the 3rd
Failing criteria: Only the first file kept; verify fires early

Passing criteria: Container splits across the 3 inputs
Failing criteria: Stuck - one file can't satisfy 3 (open: does a split count as 'all filled'?)

Passing criteria: Each file routes to its own input in order
Failing criteria: All files land on the first input

Passing criteria: 2 same-schema files merge other 2 go direct
Failing criteria: 4th file dropped or a phantom input appears

Passing criteria: Sheets split into the 3 inputs from one file
Failing criteria: Only the first sheet read

Passing criteria: Sheet-routing rule feeds the 4 inputs; unions where needed
Failing criteria: Sheets mis-routed to the wrong input

Passing criteria: Verify doesn't fire; empty input flagged red "required - no file yet"
Failing criteria: Advances with a required input still empty

Passing criteria: Extra file handled clearly (flag / ask)
Failing criteria: 4th silently stacks on the first input (current behaviour - TBD)

Passing criteria: Odd file flagged 'mismatch' at mapping; user re-maps or drops it
Failing criteria: Mismatched file merged silently; columns misaligned

Passing criteria: Removing a required file re-blocks the step
Failing criteria: One-shot verify doesn't re-fire; advances with a gap (open: bug?)

Passing criteria: Extras flagged
Failing criteria: Files 4-5 stack on the first input with no notice

Action: PDF simple - 1 PDF (1 page) to 1 input
Passing criteria: Binds then goes to field extraction (not column mapping)
Failing criteria: Treated as csv; mapping step shown

Action: Multi-page PDF - 1 PDF (12 pages) to 1 input
Passing criteria: Each page becomes a record; no page cap
Failing criteria: Only the first page read

Action: PDF fan-in - 3 PDFs (same type) to 1 input
Passing criteria: Extracted records appended
Failing criteria: Only one PDF kept

Passing criteria: Packet bursts into the 3 doc types
Failing criteria: Whole packet dumped into one input

Action: PDF multi-file - 3 distinct PDFs to 3 inputs
Passing criteria: Each doc type routes to its input
Failing criteria: Misrouted

Passing criteria: 1 image = 1 doc/page; OCR then extract
Failing criteria: Images rejected

Passing criteria: Field flagged low_confidence / type_mismatch; Confirm / Edit / Skip before run
Failing criteria: Low-confidence value used silently

Passing criteria: Null target blocks the run unless the field is optional
Failing criteria: Runs with an empty required field

Passing criteria: User can reassign the page before extraction
Failing criteria: No way to fix the routing

Passing criteria: Classifier marks it 'pending'; manual assign
Failing criteria: Force-fit into the wrong input

Passing criteria: Each routed by type; verify needs both lanes filled
Failing criteria: PDF accepted into the csv slot

Action: Mixed consolidated - 3 csv + 2 PDF to 1 csv + 1 PDF
Passing criteria: Each type consolidates within its lane; no cross-type union
Failing criteria: csv and PDF merged into one input

Passing criteria: Sheets split into 3; PDFs append to 1
Failing criteria: Sheets or PDFs dropped

Action: One lane empty - 2 csv + 0 PDF for 2 csv + 1 PDF
Passing criteria: Verify blocked until the PDF lane is filled
Failing criteria: Advances with the PDF input empty

Action: Expand an input to map columns
Passing criteria: Alignment table shows source/target/confidence; bands green >=85 yellow 60-84 red <60
Failing criteria: Confidence missing or bands wrong

Passing criteria: Selections hold; search filters columns
Failing criteria: Toggles reset when the row is collapsed

Action: Edit an input with no file
Passing criteria: Edit disabled; row greyed
Failing criteria: Opens an empty mapping table

Passing criteria: 3s "confirming mappings" then step 4
Failing criteria: Proceeds with unmapped required columns

Passing criteria: Asks matching logic + tolerance inline; default +/-5%
Failing criteria: Runs without tolerance set

Passing criteria: Skeleton while running; "Finished - N rows M records scanned"
Failing criteria: Spins forever / no result; double-run possible during a run

Passing criteria: "Hit an error - try again, or restart"
Failing criteria: Silent failure; stuck skeleton

Passing criteria: Output card (summary, KPIs, table) then save modal
Failing criteria: Save before preview / no output to save

Passing criteria: RACM disabled until BP chosen and filtered by it; save disabled until name + BP + RACM filled
Failing criteria: Save allowed with BP/RACM missing

Passing criteria: "X saved to BP / RACM"; button locks to Saved
Failing criteria: Re-save creates a duplicate; draft lost if the save fails
